chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from Ja'far ibn Sama'ah and Salih ibn Khalid from Abu Jameelah from Zayd from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the brothers from the mother with the grandfather, he (peace be upon him) said: 'For the brothers from the mother is their share, being one-third, with the grandfather.'

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: Maternal half-brothers (sharing the mother but not the father)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal half-brothers when inheriting with the grandfather?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific inheritance share of maternal half-brothers (إخوة من الأم) as one-third when they inherit alongside the paternal grandfather, a ruling derived from the chain of transmission through Ja'far ibn Sam'ah. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the grandfather's role as a primary heir who does not exclude these half-siblings, distinguishing the maternal link from the paternal line in the distribution of the estate.

en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Ja’far Bin Sama’at and Salih Bin Khalid, from Abu Jameela, from Zayd,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the brothers from the mother, with the grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the brothers from the mother is their Obligations (legislated share), being the one-third, with the grandfather’.
en.sarwar: 6. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Ja‘far ibn Sama‘ah and Salih ibn Khalid from abu Jamilah from Zayd who has narrated the following:

“About the case of a man who leaves behind brothers from his mother with a grandfather, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The ordained shares of brothers from one’s mother is one-third if a grandfather is with them.’”
